title: Kissed Spicy French Duck Rillettes
description: A spicy and indulgent French dish featuring tender duck, served in hard taco shells with a rich and creamy score fat sauce, this recipe is a unique twist on traditional rillettes, made satvik-friendly by using plant-based ingredients where necessary, and cooked to perfection on a comal.
instructions: Preheat the comal over medium heat.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped onion, minced garlic, spicy paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the duck breast to the bowl and mix until the meat is evenly coated with the spice mixture.
Place the duck breast on the preheated comal and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees.
Remove the duck from the comal and let it rest for 5 minutes before shredding it into bite-sized pieces.
In a small bowl, mix together the score fat and chopped cilantro.
To assemble the rillettes, fill each hard taco shell with a spoonful of the shredded duck, followed by a dollop of the score fat sauce.
Serve the rillettes immediately, garnished with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
